issuing_body: Minnesota Office of the Revisor of Statutes
title: Minn. Stat. § 609.5313 — Forfeiture by Judicial Action; Procedure
supports: Judicial forfeiture under §§ 609.5311 and 609.5312 proceeds through a separate complaint by the prosecuting authority against the property.
If required notice is not sent and no extension applies, the 'appropriate agency' must return seized property, illustrating the statute's separate roles for prosecuting authority and seizing agency.
selected_locators: Paragraph (a) — separate forfeiture complaint and notice by prosecuting authority
Paragraph (b) — return of property by appropriate agency when notice requirements are not met
important_qualifications: The Attorney General can be a prosecuting authority in matters within statutory jurisdiction; that does not itself place MFCU in § 609.531's separate list of 'appropriate agencies.'
